text:
maria: Quick sync — planning to enable the new caching+batching ff in canary tonight. Need an owner for monitoring during the rollout and a short checklist. thinking canary audiences: 2% global -> 10% west -> 50% all regions. @liam @sasha can you confirm?

liam: I can own monitoring. i'll hook up the datadog dashboard and alert. key metrics: p95 latency, p99 latency, tokens/sec, token-cost-per-1M, error-rate, batch-size distribution.

sasha: fyi risks: cold-kv miss spike, batch-size regression for low-latency tails, and potential KV eviction if we change TTLs. we should run a synthetic load against canary model before enabling.

anya: flag config i propose: 
```json
{
  "flag": "enable_batch_kv_cache_v2",
  "canary": {
    "phases": [
      {"pct": 2, "regions": "all"},
      {"pct": 10, "regions": "us-west"},
      {"pct": 50, "regions": "all"}
    ],
    "auto_rollback_on": ["p99>400ms", "error_rate>0.5%"]
  },
  "kill_switch": "disable_batch_kv_cache_v2"
}
```

rick: please add me to the runbook page before you start: /runbooks/cache-batching-rollout. escalation: oncall -> eng-runtime lead -> infra. i'll be online for the 2% window.

deploy-bot: scheduled canary rollout created by anya at 2026-03-17T20:05:00Z — phases: 2% (5m), 10% (15m), 50% (30m). health checks: ddog:cache-batch-health, ddog:request-latency. Auto-rollback enabled.

liam: quick perf targets to validate during canary: p95 < 120ms (no more than +20% vs baseline), p99 < 350ms, error rate < 0.3%, median batch size stable +/- 10%, token-cost delta < 15%. if p99 > 350ms hold and roll back.

maria: can we get a small pre-roll checklist? mine: 1) perf smoke in staging, 2) verify dashboard and alerts, 3) tag deploy-bot job, 4) share rollback commands in thread, 5) notify support. anything else?

sasha: add: 6) KV eviction check (monitor "kv.evictions_per_min") and 7) run a canary set with cold cache (restart node + run 500 requests).

anya: rollback commands (quick):
```
# kill switch
POST /flags/disable enable_batch_kv_cache_v2
# manual deploy rollback (if needed)
POST /deploys/rollback?job=canary-batch-cache
```
(ops-only endpoints)

liam: i'll create the datadog alert queries now and post links. also i will run the cold-cache test: `wrk -t8 -c200 -d60s https://canary.internal/api/generate` and gather p95/p99.

anya: pre-roll perf numbers (staging cold-cache run): median 95ms, p95 128ms, p99 310ms, error 0.05%, avg batch size 6. baseline p95 was 100ms so p95 +28%. tagging @maria for decision.

maria: thanks. p95 is a little high vs baseline but p99 within target. given +28% at p95 let's proceed cautiously: start 2% for 15m instead of 5m and watch p95/p99 closely. if liam sees p95 >150ms or any p99 spike, kill it.

rick: i'll be oncall and ready to flip kill-switch. pls set a pager on `ddog:cache-batch-p99` if it crosses 350ms for 3mins.

deploy-bot: canary phase 1 (2%) started at 2026-03-17T20:20:00Z. monitoring: ddog links posted to #incidents.

liam: phase1 quick snapshot after 5m: p95 118ms, p99 320ms, errors 0.07%, evictions 0/min. looks stable so far. increasing to 10% in us-west in 10m unless objections.

maria: proceed. i'll notify support and sales that we may have a short degradation window. :thumbsup:

sasha: if anything weird shows on evictions or memory pressure, remember to clear prefix cache for affected models: `redis-cli EVAL \"return redis.call('DEL', KEYS[1])\" 1 model:prefix:*` — but only after rollback is confirmed.

anya: noted. i'll update the runbook with the exact kill-switch command and the deploy job id.

maria: thanks team — please post final state here once 50% completes or if we rollback. keeping thread as the single source of truth. :white_check_mark:
